stages.next_action: Preserve A0 as passed; all later work remains offline and checksummed.
stages.objective: Freeze the research-only mandate, capital and risk boundary, stage graph, durable handoff and fail-closed validator.
stages.pass_gate: Contracts are canonical, unsafe runtime assumptions fail closed, no instrument or strategy is approved, and actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: Preserve the passed hourly data and no_trade masks without reopening source selection.
stages.objective: Qualify an account-specific OANDA broker-native research universe with immutable bid/ask data, causal timestamps, availability masks and intraday cost semantics.
stages.pass_gate: The required cross-asset roles pass hourly identity, timestamp, history-edge, bid/ask, complete-window and long-gap gates; incomplete windows are no_trade.

stages.next_action: Preserve the rejection, do not tune or open final evidence, and retain it only as a negative control.
stages.objective: Evaluate one frozen intraday multi-market session-breakout continuation family at fixed risk using chronological evidence.
stages.pass_gate: The trend family beats flat, matched-exposure, random-entry and simple controls after historical bid/ask and frozen slippage with acceptable uncertainty, concentration and drawdown.

stages.next_action: Preserve the rejection; do not tune, rerun, select instruments, add leverage, use a regime rescue or collect prospective evidence for this ID.
stages.objective: Evaluate the pre-result-selected, economically distinct intraday overnight-gap-reversion family.
stages.pass_gate: The family independently passes causal, cost, capacity, robustness, attribution and genuinely prospective evidence gates.

stages.activation_precondition: At least one independently accepted strategy arm from A2 or A3 is recorded; currently false.
stages.next_action: Remain planned and inactive while no accepted strategy arm exists.
stages.objective: Evaluate continuous volatility, correlation and liquidity risk scaling for accepted arms, beginning with simple EWMA and covariance controls.
stages.pass_gate: Risk scaling improves frozen tail and risk-adjusted metrics without changing forecast direction, exceeding leverage limits or depending on hindsight thresholds.

stages.next_action: Remain blocked while fewer than two economically distinct strategy arms are accepted.
stages.objective: Compare no_trade, the best single arm, a static accepted-arm blend and a deterministic risk-aware router using one shared capital account.
stages.pass_gate: At least two economically distinct arms are accepted and routing adds stable net value after costs, uncertainty, turnover and concentration while actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: Require a new execution mandate, exact venue, credentials review and explicit written approval before any live-capital proposal.
stages.objective: Prospectively paper-observe each accepted arm and the shared-capital portfolio with availability, forecasts, fills, costs, risk and decay attribution.
stages.pass_gate: The frozen observer completes its predeclared duration and opportunity minimums without evidence contamination, unresolved operational failures or drawdown-limit breaches.
